entries.title: Jonah 2:1
segments: ¶Then Jonah made prayer to the Lord his God from the inside of the fish, and said,

entries.title: Jonah 2:2
segments: In my trouble I was crying to the Lord, and he gave me an answer; out of the deepest underworld I sent up a cry, and you gave ear to my voice.

entries.title: Jonah 2:3
segments: For you have put me down into the deep, into the heart of the sea; and the river was round about me; all your waves and your rolling waters went over me.

entries.title: Jonah 2:4
segments: And I said, I have been sent away from before your eyes; how may I ever again see your holy Temple?

entries.title: Jonah 2:5
segments: The waters were circling round me, even to the neck; the deep was about me; the sea-grass was twisted round my head.

entries.title: Jonah 2:6
segments: I went down to the bases of the mountains; as for the earth, her walls were about me for ever: but you have taken up my life from the underworld, O Lord my God.

entries.title: Jonah 2:7
segments: When my soul in me was overcome, I kept the memory of the Lord: and my prayer came in to you, into your holy Temple.

entries.title: Jonah 2:8
segments: The worshippers of false gods have given up their only hope.

entries.title: Jonah 2:9
segments: But I will make an offering to you with the voice of praise; I will give effect to my oaths. Salvation is the Lord's.

entries.title: Jonah 2:10
segments: ¶And at the Lord's order, the fish sent Jonah out of its mouth on to the dry land.
